function plan({values,today}){if(!Array.isArray(values))throw Error('Invalid sheet');if(values.length===0)return{messages:[]};const headers=values[0];if(!Array.isArray(headers))throw Error('Missing sheet headers');const names=['ID','Name','Email','Date','Status','Title','Subject'],columns={};for(const name of names){const matches=headers.flatMap((x,i)=>x===name?[i]:[]);if(matches.length!==1)throw Error('Each required header must occur exactly once');columns[name]=matches[0]}if(typeof today!=='string'||!/^\d{4}\/\d\d\/\d\d$/.test(today))throw Error('Invalid current date');const ids=new Map();for(const row of values.slice(1)){if(!Array.isArray(row))throw Error('Invalid sheet row');const id=row[columns.ID];if(id!=null&&String(id)!=='')ids.set(String(id),(ids.get(String(id))??0)+1)}const messages=[];for(const row of values.slice(1)){if(row[columns.Status]!=='Waiting for sending'||row[columns.Date]!==today||!['Name','Email','Date','Title','Subject'].every(k=>row[columns[k]]!=null&&String(row[columns[k]])!==''))continue;const id=row[columns.ID];if(id==null||String(id)===''||ids.get(String(id))!==1)throw Error('Missing or duplicate message ID');messages.push(Object.fromEntries(names.map(k=>[k,String(row[columns[k]]??'')])))}return{messages};}

return plan({values:$input.first().json.values??[],today:$("Choose the customer messages sheet").first().json.today}).messages.map(x=>({json:x}));

function match({values,current,sheetName}){if(!Array.isArray(values)||!Array.isArray(values[0])||!current||typeof current.ID!=='string')throw Error('Invalid current message');const h=values[0],fields=['ID','Name','Email','Date','Status','Title','Subject'],c={};for(const k of fields){const p=h.flatMap((x,i)=>x===k?[i]:[]);if(p.length!==1)throw Error('Missing or duplicate required header');c[k]=p[0]}const found=values.slice(1).flatMap((row,i)=>Array.isArray(row)&&String(row[c.ID]??'')===current.ID?[{row,i}]:[]);if(found.length!==1)throw Error('Message ID no longer uniquely identifies a row');const {row,i}=found[0];for(const k of fields)if(String(row[c[k]]??'')!==current[k])throw Error('Message row changed after sending');let col=c.Status+1,letters='';while(col){col--;letters=String.fromCharCode(65+col%26)+letters;col=Math.floor(col/26)}if(typeof sheetName!=='string'||!sheetName.trim())throw Error('Missing worksheet name');return{range:"'"+sheetName.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'!"+letters+(i+2),values:[['Sent successfully']]};}

return [{json:match({values:$input.first().json.values??[],current:$("Process messages one by one").item.json,sheetName:$("Choose the customer messages sheet").first().json.sheetName})}];
